senses.gloss: ज्य , ज्यका See √ 1. ज्या and 3. ज्या॑.
ज्य mfn. ifc. ‘oppressing’, see ब्रह्म-ज्य॑.
2. ज्या॑ f. = βία, see परम-ज्या॑
excessive demand, ŚBr. v, 4, 5, 4.
3. ज्या॑ f. a bow-string, βιός RV.; AV.; VS. &c.
(in geom.) the chord of an arc
= ज्यार्ध, Sūryas.
cf. अधि-, उज्-, परम-, वि- and स-ज्य
एक-, क्रम-, क्रान्ति-.
4. ज्या f. the earth, L.
a mother, L.
ज्या॑न n. oppression, iv, 1, 2, 4.
ज्यानि॑ f. (Pāṇ. iii, 3, 95, Vārtt. 4) id., MaitrS. ii, 2, 10 (cf. अ॑-)
‘loss’, see सर्व-ज्यानी॑
disappearance, Mālatīm. ix, 33
infirmity, old age, Vop. xi, 2
a river, L.
ज्याय See नृ-ज्याय॑.
ज्या॑यस् mfn. (Pāṇ. v, 3, 61 f.; vi, 4, 160) superior, more excellent, greater, larger, stronger, RV. &c. (ifc. [e.g. वचन-, ‘superior in speech’, Kāś.] Pāṇ. vi, 2, 25)
elder, RV. &c.
most excellent, Ragh. xviii, 33
(in law) being of age and answerable for one's conduct, W.
ज्यायस्—त्व n. superiority, Bādar. iii, 3, 57, Sch.
ज्या॑यस्—वत् (ज्या॑य्˚), mfn. having a superior, AV. iii.
(others, ‘following a leader, obedient’; others, ‘excellent, superior’).
ज्यायस॑ mfn. greater in number, ŚBr. xiv, 4, 1.
ज्यायिष्ठ mfn. (irr. superl.) most excellent, first, best, MBh. vii, 3701; Hariv. 7265.
ज्यायु a bow-string, Kauś.
ज्या—कार॑ m. a bow-string-maker, VS. xxx, 7.
ज्या—˚कृष्टि (ज्याक्˚) f. straining a bow-string, Amar. (Vcar.)
ज्या—घोष॑ m. the twang of a bow, AV. v, 21, 9; MBh. xiii, 7471.
ज्या—निवारण n. a leathern fence for the arm, L.
ज्या—पाश॑ m. a bow-string, AV. xi, 10, 22; Kauś.; MBh. iv, 164.
ज्या—पिण्ड a-sine expressed in figures, Sūryas. ii, 31 f.
ज्या—पिण्˚डक a-sine expressed in figures, Sūryas. ii, 31 f.

ज्या—मघ m. N. of Vidarbha's father, Hariv. 1980 ff.; BhP. ix, 23, 33 ff.
ज्य्—˚आरोहण n. the fixing a bow-string, Cat.
ज्या˚र्ध m. (ज्यार्˚) the sine of an arc, Sūryas. ii, 15
ज्या॑—वाज (ज्या॑-), mfn. having the elasticity of a bow-string, RV. iii, 53, 24.
